tg.name: A52c - Colma di Vercio - Cima Corte Lorenzo

tg.note: Relation with photos (click on → Web site) mantained by CAI Sezioni Est Monterosa DB

n: A54 - Bracchio - Cappella di Erfo - Monte Faiè

tg.name: A54 - Bracchio - Cappella di Erfo - Monte Faiè
tg.description: From Lake Mergozzo, Bracchio fraction, through Alpe Boscopiano and Alpe Ompio with the Refuge Fantoli up to 1352 meters of Mount Faiè. The path, after the recent intervention of Cai Pallanza, cleaning and makeover signs, is now easily passable.
tg.note: Relation with photos (click on → Web site) mantained by CAI Sezioni Est Monterosa DB

n: A52 - Mergozzo - Bracchio - Vercio - Monte Faiè

tg.name: A52 - Mergozzo - Bracchio - Vercio - Monte Faiè
tg.description: From Mergozzo lake to Monte Faiè the initial chestnut trees give way up to the beech trees while you gain altitude on the ancient cobbled mule track to the Vercio Hermitage and then on to the ridge with breathtaking views of the Gulf Borromeo and Stresa
tg.note: Relation with photos (click on → Web site) mantained by CAI Sezioni Est Monterosa DB
tg.to: Colma di Vercio e Monte Faiè

tg.name: P02 - Cossogno - Pizzo Pernice
tg.description: From Cossogno amidst chestnut on the ancient cobbled mule track to Alpe Rugno, then for the meadows of high pastures and finally the long panoramic ridge that culminates at Pizzo Pernice
tg.note: Relation with photos (click on → Web site) mantained by Danilo (CAI Pallanza)

n: P01 - Madonna di campagna - Monterosso - Cavandone

tg.name: P01 - Madonna di campagna - Monterosso - Cavandone
tg.description: An easy walk on Monterosso, mountain overlooking Verbania. Roads and firebreaks facilitate the journey. A picnic area with views of Stresa and the Borromeo Gulf is a pleasant stopover to climb term
tg.note: Relation with photos (click on → Web site) mantained by Danilo (CAI Pallanza)

tg.name: A00 - Strada Romana (terza sezione)

n: P07a - Cappella Or Vergugn - Ponte Velina

tg.note: Relation with photos (click on → Web site) mantained by CAI Sezioni Est Monterosa DB

tg.name: P07 - Rovegro - Alpe Buè
tg.description: The mountaineers came in the lower Valgrande along two lines that from Rovegro to Or Vergugn were common then one continued for Velina, Futt Bridge, Orfalecchio to Rodugno, ours for Scellina as far as Corte Buè, besides it was dangerous
tg.note: Relation with photos (click on → Web site) mantained by CAI Sezioni Est Monterosa DB

tg.name: XP1A - Ponte Casletto - Ponte Velina
tg.description: A daring and challenging route that runs along the steep side of the Rio Valgrande with frequent dripping tunnels where an open-air water conduit flows, dilapidated small bridge and a Tibetan Bridge are the final highlight.
tg.note: Attention: exposed paths, short rocky passages with chains

tg.name: P05 - Cappella di Erfo - Rovegro
